name: BCH Camp (Barbara C. Harris Camp)
operator_name: Barbara C. Harris Camp & Conference Center (Episcopal Diocese of Massachusetts)
description_short: Episcopal overnight camp on Otter Lake in Greenfield, NH, with sessions for kindergarten through 12th grade plus a family camp weekend. Activities include boating, fishing, archery, a ropes course, rock climbing, arts and crafts, and daily faith activities.
special_needs_notes: The page has an inclusion statement saying people of all abilities are welcome. It does not describe any specific accommodations.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp has a waterfront on Otter Lake; the page mentions boating, fishing, canoeing and swimming. It does not describe swim tests or lifeguard details.

sessions.name: Family Camp (all ages; per person, kids under 5 free; $250-$350/person by housing)

warnings: Only the 2026 season is shown, and it is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is published.
The Intersession Weekend dates as written ('July 16-19th and/or 24-26th') overlap the end or start of the youth sessions. They are recorded as stated; confirm with the camp.
Family Camp is priced per person by housing type ($250-$350; kids under 5 free), not per camper, so no single session price is recorded.
The Alumni Overnight (June 20-21, 2026) and the Open House (June 21) are for adults and the community, not camper sessions, so they are left out.
Footer copyright says 2021 and the page also has a Google Forms registration link; the CampBrain link is used as the main registration URL.
